content.text:
Read AGENTS.md, then .prod-build/briefs/T07c.md and do exactly that task.
Finish by writing .prod-build/reports/T07c.md in the format at the end of the brief, commit on this branch (do not push), and reply with the report.

result.output:
1	# T07c Bring every county onto the page: the one-precinct-per-page layout, county tabs and the run's summary — AC-6, M8
2	Context: the page shows one county, Panola, whose sheet is a matrix. The run over the whole benchmark now exists (`runs/20261011-130414`, with `summary.json`): seven counties were read, six of them in the other layout (portrait pages, one precinct per section, each row a label and four figures: total, absentee, early voting, election day), and one county has nothing printed to check against. This task puts all of them on the page. The branch `site` contains `main` up to that run. BASE: the current HEAD.
3	Read first: AGENTS.md, UI-SPEC.md (sections 1, 5, 9, 12), site/ (all files), crossfoot/sitebuild.py, crossfoot/layouts/report.py (the field notes at its top), `runs/20261011-130414/summary.json`, `runs/20261011-130414/san_saba/county.json` and `findings.json`, `runs/20261011-130414/jones/findings.json`, .prod-build/reports/T07b.md
4	
5	Done when (REQUIRED): `uv run python -m crossfoot.sitebuild --run 20261011-130414` builds every county of the run into `site/data/`; the page opens on Panola exactly as now; the county tabs switch to any other county and show its first finding (or its empty or not-checked state) drawn on its scan, with both readings of the row and the row's sum both ways; a line for the whole run is on the first screen; axe reports no violations; `uv run pytest -q` passes.
6	
7	Data (`crossfoot/sitebuild.py`):
8	- A run made by `audit --all` has one folder per county and a `summary.json`. Build all of them: `index.json` lists the counties in the run's order with status, layout, pages, findings by status, the sums check and whether the county has a second sum, plus the run's totals (counties, findings, settled, cannot verify, printed sums in all and holding with the published and with the corrected files, model calls, metered cost, seconds). A county the run did not check (`no_printed_totals`) is listed with its reason and gets no county file beyond that.
9	- In the report layout the four values of a row share one box (the row's strip) and blocks have no box. For each row that carries a finding, cut a clean crop from the page at 300 dpi: the row with the contest heading, the column headings and two rows of context above and below where the page has them (no outline and no caption drawn into the image), and record in the county JSON the crop's place on the page, the row's box inside it, and, where it can be found from the ink (clusters of ink at the right end of the row, right to left, mapped through the county's column order), a box for each of the four figures; a figure that cannot be found has a null box and the row box is used. Tested on a small made-up page image.
10	- Page images at 1,600 px are written only for the pages that carry a finding, and page 1 of each county; other pages are listed with their numbers and no image. Report what the whole `site/data/` weighs; keep it under 25 MB.
11	
12	The page:
13	- County tabs in the top bar, in the run's order, each with its number of disagreements in Courier Prime ("Panola 121"); a county that was not checked is a tab too, marked with a dash. `?county=<name>` selects one. Arrow keys move between tabs (one tab stop). On small screens the tabs scroll sideways inside the bar without moving the page.
14	- A whole-run line, quiet, on the first screen at 1440x900 and above the stage on small screens, built from `index.json` only: for example "8 counties · 7 read · 228 disagreements · 186 settled by the printed totals · 0 confirmed by a person · 4,839 printed sums: 4,737 hold with the published files, 4,803 with the corrected". Do not type any of these figures in; if the build has one county only, show nothing.
15	- The stage for the report layout: the page is portrait, so fit it in the sheet zone by height and keep the same tilt, stack and shadow. The selected finding's row gets one band across the row (the row's own sum: `--data-holds` when the row adds up on the scan, `--data-fails` when it does not) and, where the county has a contest total and that sum is in the finding, a band down the figure's column to the contest total row. The ring: a pencil loop round the figure when its box is known, else round the row's figures.
16	- The loupe shows the row's clean crop at reading size (figures at least 16 px tall), with the loop on the figure, and the tag in the blank part of the row: `public file: {value}`; for a row where two figures differ, one tag naming both ("public file: early voting 189 · election day 162"). Its caption line gives page, precinct, contest and row label.
17	- The card for a row: `Public file` and `Scan` each as the row's four figures in a line (total, absentee, early voting, election day; Courier Prime; the figures that differ are the strong ones), then the kind of slip and one sentence, then the status. For `cannot verify` in this layout use the finding's own reason in one plain sentence: "Both rows add up to their own total, and nothing else printed on this page can tell them apart. Left as published." followed by, when the finding records it, "The scan was read twice and both readings agree." Never say which is right.
18	- The tape: the row's sum with the public file's row and with the scan's row, side by side as now (four lines each, so no shortening); under it the contest column's sum both ways where the finding has it.
19	- The list groups by row; its lines show the part, the two values and the status as now.
20	- Empty county (no disagreements): the copy deck's empty line in the list, the first page on the stage with no marks, and a line from the data: "{n} of {n} printed sums hold with the published file."
21	- A county that was not checked: the stage shows only the sentence from the run ("Nothing on this scan can be cross-checked; left as published."), the panel is empty apart from the headline strip saying the same; Replay is disabled with that reason.
22	- The replay for a report county uses its own events (the sample, one step per page read, the rows that were read again, then the audit); it needs no new beats, only that a page read washes the page and a re-read row is shown in the loupe. Check its timeline builds for San Saba and Jones.
23	- Panola must look and behave exactly as before this task (compare `qa/t07b/open-1440.png` with a new screenshot).
24	
25	Wording: row labels come from the data as printed on the scan; no sentence about any candidate, party or official; nothing says a person has confirmed a finding; a status never claims more than the finding's own record.
26	
27	Look at it: screenshots at 1440x900 and 390x844 of Panola (opening), San Saba (opening, and one cannot-verify row), Jones (a settled row), Cottle (empty), Limestone (not checked), the tabs with keyboard focus, and one replay still for San Saba; under `qa/t07c/`. Open every one and fix what is off: a portrait sheet that leaves the stage, a loupe crop cut through a row, tags over figures, tabs that wrap. Re-run axe (scripts in `qa/t07b/`) on each of those states at both sizes: zero violations, results in `qa/t07c/axe.json`.
28	
29	You own (REQUIRED): modify site/ (all files), crossfoot/sitebuild.py, tests/test_sitebuild.py; create qa/t07c/. Touch nothing else: not hackathon.md, not .prod-build/plan.json, not .prod-build/evidence.jsonl, not any other file under crossfoot/.
30	Out of scope: deploy, any change to reading or auditing, the README.
31	
32	Verify (REQUIRED):
33	1. uv run pytest -q
34	2. uv run python -m crossfoot.sitebuild --run 20261011-130414
35	3. axe with zero violations (qa/t07c/axe.json), and the screenshots above, looked at.
36	Do not use `python3 .prod-build/pb.py` in this worktree (its files belong to the main branch).
37	Protected: never edit, skip or loosen existing tests, test configs, the hooks in .claude/, the files in .entire/, or the plan's acceptance and verify fields.
38	STOP and report BLOCKED (don't improvise) if the work needs anything this brief doesn't describe: a destructive operation, a secrets change, a push or any other external side effect, a missing credential, or the spec contradicts itself.
39	Never print secrets in command output (the ledger stores output tails).
40	Finish: write .prod-build/reports/T07c.md in this exact format, then commit your changes together with the report as "T07c: <outcome>" (commit only; never push); don't start other tasks:
41	  STATUS: DONE | DONE_WITH_CONCERNS | BLOCKED | NEEDS_CONTEXT
42	  COMMITS: <base7>..<head7> — <subjects>
43	  FILES: <git diff --stat BASE..HEAD, raw>
44	  EVIDENCE: <E-ids: RED, verify runs> (raw last lines of any failure)
45	  RULINGS: <decision made where the brief was silent — why — cost if wrong> | none
46	  MEMORY: applied <ids> (helpful | harmful | n/a); new failure worth recording: <one line> | none
47	  CONCERNS / BLOCKER: <specific; what was tried; what is needed>
48

Exact `git diff --stat` is in the commit (67 files, 1712 insertions, 105 deletions).
EVIDENCE: no ledger (pb.py not used here, as the brief says).
- `uv run pytest -q`: 124 passed (3 new in tests/test_sitebuild.py: verdicts and summary figures are passed on; total seconds of a resumed run; the replay timeline follows the run's events, which runs `node qa/t07b/timeline.mjs` and is skipped if node is missing).
- `uv run python -m crossfoot.sitebuild --run 20261011-120008`: wrote site/data/index.json and panola.json; only panola.json changed (new keys `vd`, `sm`); pages, blocks, crops are byte-identical.
- Timeline check (qa/t07b/timeline.json, built from the real site/data/panola.json): 57 steps = 1 sample, 50 read (one per block_read event, in event order), 1 check, 3 suspect (one per suspect event, in event order), 1 audit, 1 end; 30.2 s at the default speed; failures: none. Also checks that no events gives no steps and no sample figures gives no sample step.
- Replay measured in the browser (qa/t07b/checks.json): 30.2 s at 1x, label `Replay · run of 11 Oct 2026 · 21x` (run.json seconds 638.7 / 30.2 = 21.1). At 2x: 15.1 s, label 42x (42.3). At 4x: 7.6 s, label 85x (84.8). Under prefers-reduced-motion: 30.4 s, 43 distinct captions, no animation running other than 150 ms opacity fades.
- axe 4.12.1 (wcag2a, 2aa, 21a, 21aa, 22aa), qa/t07b/axe.json: 0 violations in 14 runs: `/`, a paused replay at four beats (reading, a re-read, the document disagrees, the audit), `?record=1`, `?record=1` with a paused replay, each at 1440x900 and 390x844. (A first run found color-contrast on the card and list while the replay was paused, because "quiet" was 50 percent opacity; changed to 86 percent, contrast 4.8 or more.)
- First screen at 1440x900, no input (qa/t07b/checks.json, `first-1440x900`): the panel is 68 to 846; the headline strip, the card (both values), both deciding sums with their verdicts ("does not match" with the file's value, "matches" with the scan's), the filter chips on one line, 2 group lines and 3 finding rows are fully inside it with the panel not scrolled. At 1024x768 and 390x844 and 320x640: no sideways scroll; at 390 both values end at y 633, above the bottom bar at 756; at 320 they end at 548, bar at 552.
- `?record=1` at 160 percent zoom (a 900x562 window at 1.6 pixel ratio, qa/t07b/zoom160.json and zoom160-record-*.png): the headline strip fits in 2 lines, the caption wraps to two lines and the loupe is moved down to clear it; no sideways scroll.
- Other behaviour (checks.json): button reads `Pause replay` while running and `Resume replay` when paused (Escape, Alt+Shift+P and the button each work; the caption holds while paused); card and findings carry aria-busy while it runs and lose it at the end; caption is aria-live polite at 13 px; selecting a finding by hand stops the replay and leaves the finished page (full count back, loupe back, no caption); at the end the page is the same as before (selected finding, card title, tag, count, page all equal); with the events stripped from the county's data the button is disabled and the hint reads "Replay comes with the run's events".
- Screenshots (all opened): replay stills at 1440 and 390 for each beat (sample, sample read, read page 3, read page 6, check, suspect first read, suspect read again, document disagrees, audit page 1, audit later page, end) plus replay-paused-*; one run under reduced motion at 1440; open at 1440, 1024, 390, 320; cannot-verify and wrong-number findings at 1440 and 390; 160 percent zoom of `?record=1` (opening and replay).
RULINGS:
- The sample beat frames the sampled blocks with a neutral dashed line, not in --data-fails. The run recorded only how many of the sample's row sums failed (6 of 22), not which, so painting named sums red would invent them; the caption carries the figures. Cost if wrong: one more colour to change in replay.js (`.rp .frame` in styles.css).
- The 7 reads the sample made with claude-haiku are read steps too (one per block_read event, so the timeline test holds), with their own caption ("Sample read with claude-haiku, page 1: k of 7 blocks"); the count "k of all" is kept per pass (the 43 reads after the reader was chosen say "k of 43"). Washes of the sample pass stay until the second pass starts. Cost if wrong: the read beat is 7 steps longer.
- One beat per `suspect` event (3 here). The fourth item the run worked (REGISTERED row, verdict cannot_verify) has no suspect event, so it has no beat; the cannot_verify caption and the amber ring are built (reason cut to its first sentence) and are not shown by this data. No finding has the status document_inconsistent in this run, so there is no such finding to open; the document-disagrees still is the replay beat (`replay-08-document-disagrees-*.png`, the 1,079 on page 6).
- The terms in the tape's two-column sums are plain lines, no longer buttons. Two sums only fit the first screen with 16 px lines, and axe's 24 px target rule (wcag22aa) does not allow 16 px buttons side by side. The same value can still be reached by the sheet and the list. Cost if wrong: re-add the button for the first and last term (about 16 px more height per sum).
- The tape's column headers carry the sums' names ("Public file · row EARLY", "Scan · column 18"); the longer name stays as a screen-reader heading. Long sums show the first term, the term that differs and the last, with a line for each run left out (a run of one is shown as its own line).
- The card's kind of slip and its sentence run on in one paragraph; "Decided by" is gone; the h2 is one line, cut with an ellipsis, with the full label in the loupe's caption and as a title. The list's own heading is visually hidden (the headline strip says what the list holds) but stays as its accessible name.
- Headline strip: sticky at the top of the panel at 1440, plain above 900 px. It shows zeros while the replay runs and counts up page by page in the audit beat (findings by the page they sit on), ending on the true figures.
- The tag `public file: {value}` sits in the blank left part of the same cell, level with the ring, when it fits; otherwise just above the loupe's top edge with a one-pixel line down to the ring (the caption above the loupe moves aside). During the replay the same tag hangs under the loupe's bottom edge instead, because the replay's caption is above.
- Marks for findings are hollow circles 9 px across with a 2 px stroke, kept the same size on screen as the old ticks.
- Escape pauses a running replay (it does not resume); Alt+Shift+P starts, pauses and resumes. An open dialog keeps Escape for itself.
- At 2x and 4x the stage animations are off (states change at once) so the label stays true; at 1x they run. The replay has its own clock, so a step that runs long is made up by the steps after it.
- "Quiet" while the replay runs is 86 percent opacity plus aria-busy, because 50 percent failed contrast.
- Minutes: a run that was resumed counts the runs it resumed (`seconds_total` in `run_info`, written by sitebuild, only when every run recorded its seconds); if one did not, the minutes figure is left out. `--run latest` (20261011-121108) built into a scratch folder gives 177.7 + 638.7 = 816.4 s, 13.6 minutes; the shipped build (120008, not resumed) still says 10.6.
- Not touched, as the brief says: hackathon.md (AGENTS.md asks for a build-log entry there; none was written by this task), .prod-build/plan.json, evidence.jsonl.
MEMORY: applied none (pb.py not usable here; docs/memory/INDEX.md has no records); new failure worth recording: pausing a replay by pausing every running animation left the page-turn clone of the old sheet on screen (the "leaving" copy is a Web Animation); short entrances and the clone must be finished, not paused.
CONCERNS / BLOCKER:
- The first screen was measured with fallback faces: the headless browser could not load Public Sans and Courier Prime from Google Fonts. The third finding row ends about 18 px above the panel's bottom edge, so a wider real face that wraps the headline to three lines or the card's unconfirmed line to two would push it below. Needs one look on a machine with the fonts.
- The sample beat does not show which sums failed (not recorded); see rulings.
- During the replay the stage keeps the loupe's slot empty, so at 390 the sheet is small with blank space above it; I did not resize the sheet for it.
- The check beat counts "7 of 984 printed sums"; 984 is the number of sums in the county's checks (`checks` in panola.json), 7 is the sum of the summary's sums_failing_before (3 row, 2 col, 1 grand, 1 grand_row).
- AGENTS.md asks for a dated entry in hackathon.md; the brief forbids touching it, so it is for whoever merges.

3	Reads runs/<run_id>/<county>/county.json (fields: see outputs.py) and writes, under site/data/:
4	  index.json           run, started, ended, counties [{key, name, file, pages}], summary {county: figures the run
5	                       recorded}, run {model_calls, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, metered_cost_estimate}
6	  <county>.json        the county, with short keys (below), no indentation
7	  pages/<county>-pN.webp   each scan page at most 1600 px wide
8	  blocks/<county>-<block id>.webp   each block cut from its page at 300 dpi, grey (for the loupe)
9	
10	Short keys in <county>.json
11	  pages   [{n, img, w, h, sc}]   n page number, img path relative to site/, w and h image pixels,
12	                                 sc = image pixels per pixel of the run's 200 dpi boxes
13	  blocks  [{id, p, contest, cand, x, bi}]        x = box in page-image pixels, or null;
14	            bi = {img, w, h, rt} the block's own 300 dpi image (the pixels of the box x), or null with x;
15	            rt = y in that image of the ruled line above the block's first row, or null if none is found
16	  values  [{p, b, r, c, v, s, x, ix, m, n}]      cells and printed totals alike, in this order
17	            p page, b block, r row kind (cell) or 'col' / 'row' / 'grand' (printed total), c column (cell) or key
18	            (printed total), v value, s status (cells only), x box in image pixels or null (never a zero box),
19	            ix = the ink box: the box of the printed figure itself, in the pixels of the block's 300 dpi image,
20	            or null when no ink is found in the value's box (a zero is ink), m model and n tries (cells only)
21	  checks  [{k, p, b, y, ok, pr, co, t}]          k row | col | grand (the small totals add to the grand total) |
22	            grand_row (the row totals add to it), y key, pr printed, co computed,
23	            t = indexes into values, in the order the sum is added
24	  events  [{t, k, p}]                            ts, kind, payload, as recorded
25	  vd      [{s, v, r, e}]                         the run's verdicts as recorded: sum key, verdict, reason, entity
26	  sm      {sums_failing_before, sums_failing_after, items_worked, cells_reread}   the summary's figures the replay reads
27	  layout, run, county                            as recorded

30	            run        the run id

56	INK_SHRINK = 3      # pixels cut off each side of a value's box, so ruled lines are left out
57	INK_BELOW = 160     # a pixel darker than this (0 black, 255 white) is ink
58	RULE_FRACTION = 0.9  # a row or column of the box this dark is a ruled line, not a figure
59	RULE_FRINGE = 2      # pixels cleared beside a ruled line, for its soft edge

63	def ink_box(im, box, shrink=INK_SHRINK, below=INK_BELOW):
64	    """The bounding box [x0, y0, x1, y1] of the ink inside `box` of the grey image `im`, the box shrunk by `shrink`
65	    pixels on every side; None when there is no ink."""
66	    x0, y0 = max(0, int(box[0] + shrink)), max(0, int(box[1] + shrink))
67	    x1, y1 = min(im.width, int(box[2] - shrink)), min(im.height, int(box[3] - shrink))
68	    if x1 <= x0 or y1 <= y0:
69	        return None
70	    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
71	    dark = im.crop((x0, y0, x1, y1)).point(lambda v: 255 if v < below else 0)
72	    # ruled lines run the whole way across the box; a figure's own strokes do not: take those lines out first
73	    cols = dark.resize((dark.width, 1), Image.BOX).tobytes()
74	    rows = dark.resize((1, dark.height), Image.BOX).tobytes()
75	    pen = ImageDraw.Draw(dark)
76	    for x, v in enumerate(cols):
77	        if v >= RULE_FRACTION * 255:
78	            pen.rectangle([x - RULE_FRINGE, 0, x + RULE_FRINGE, dark.height], fill=0)
79	    for y, v in enumerate(rows):
80	        if v >= RULE_FRACTION * 255:
81	            pen.rectangle([0, y - RULE_FRINGE, dark.width, y + RULE_FRINGE], fill=0)
82	    ink = dark.getbbox()
83	    if not ink:
84	        return None
85	    return [x0 + ink[0], y0 + ink[1], x0 + ink[2], y0 + ink[3]]

88	def block_geometry(box, frame_w, rw):
89	    """The cut of one block from the 300 dpi render: (left, top, width, height) in 300 dpi pixels.
90	    `box` is in the frame of width `frame_w`; `rw` is the width of the 200 dpi render of the same page."""
91	    k = rw * BLOCK_DPI / RENDER_DPI / frame_w
92	    return round(box[0] * k), round(box[1] * k), max(1, round((box[2] - box[0]) * k)), max(1, round((box[3] - box[1]) * k))

95	def cut_block(im, geom):
96	    """Cuts `geom` out of a page image; a cut that would run past the edge is moved back inside it."""
97	    left, top, w, h = geom
98	    left = max(0, min(left, im.width - w))
99	    top = max(0, min(top, im.height - h))
100	    return im.crop((left, top, left + w, top + h))

103	def _scale_box(box, sc):
104	    """A box in 200 dpi pixels -> image pixels; None stays None, and so does anything that is not four numbers."""
105	    if not box or len(box) != 4 or any(v is None for v in box):
106	        return None
107	    return [round(v * sc, 1) for v in box]

110	def rule_top(im, box, reach=24, dark=0.6, below=110):
111	    """The first row of pixels, from `reach` pixels above the top of `box` to a few below it, that is a ruled line
112	    (more than `dark` of the box's width darker than `below`); None when there is none."""
113	    x0, x1 = max(0, int(box[0])), min(im.width, int(box[2]))
114	    y0, y1 = max(0, int(box[1] - reach)), min(im.height, int(box[1] + 8))
115	    if x1 <= x0 or y1 <= y0:
116	        return None
117	    strip = im.crop((x0, y0, x1, y1)).point(lambda v: 255 if v < below else 0)
118	    for y in range(strip.height):
119	        if strip.crop((0, y, strip.width, y + 1)).histogram()[255] > dark * strip.width:
120	            return y0 + y
121	    return None

124	def _same_box(a, b):
125	    return bool(a) and bool(b) and len(a) == len(b) == 4 and all(abs(x - y) < 1.5 for x, y in zip(a, b))

128	def build_findings(raw: dict, index: dict, doc: dict, run: dict | None = None, path=None, evidence=None,
129	                   crop_path=lambda county, gid, src: None) -> dict:
130	    """The `fd` part of the county's JSON from a findings.json (`doc`), the run's run.json (`run`) and the county's
131	    values (`index`: (page, block, row, column) -> index into values). See the module's docstring."""
132	    county = raw["county"]
133	    blocks = {b["id"]: b for b in raw["blocks"]}
134	    boxed = [(c["page"], c["block"], c["row_kind"], str(c["column"]), c.get("box")) for c in raw["cells"]] + \
135	            [(t["page"], t["block"], t["direction"], str(t["key"]), t.get("box")) for t in raw["totals"]]
136	
137	    def label(bid, f=None):
138	        b = blocks.get(bid)
139	        if b and (b.get("candidate") or b.get("contest")):
140	            return b.get("candidate") or b["contest"]
141	        return (f or {}).get("candidate") or (f or {}).get("office") or None
142	
143	    def ref_of(f):
144	        """The finding's value on the sheet: the cell the audit compares (as crossfoot.audit.entity_key), else the
145	        value whose box is the finding's box."""
146	        p, b, part, pr = f.get("page"), f.get("block"), f.get("part"), str(f.get("precinct"))
147	        if part == "votes":
148	            keys = [(p, b, "REGISTERED", pr)] if b == "reg" else [(p, b, "col", pr)]
149	        else:
150	            keys = [(p, b, SCAN_ROW.get(part), pr)]
151	        for k in keys:
152	            if k in index:
153	                return index[k]
154	        for (bp, bb, r, c, box) in boxed:
155	            if (bp, bb) == (p, b) and _same_box(box, f.get("box")) and (bp, bb, r, c) in index:
156	                return index[(bp, bb, r, c)]
157	        return None
158	
159	    items = []
160	    for f in doc["findings"]:
161	        it = {"id": f["id"], "group": f.get("group"), "kind": f["kind"], "status": f["status"]}
162	        for k, v in (("office", f.get("office")), ("row", label(f.get("block"), f)), ("precinct", f.get("precinct")),
163	                     ("part", f.get("part")), ("file", f.get("file_value")), ("scan", f.get("scan_value")),
164	                     ("reason", f.get("reason")), ("page", f.get("page")), ("block", f.get("block"))):
165	            if v is not None and v != "":
166	                it[k] = v
167	        r = ref_of(f)
168	        if r is not None:
169	            it["ref"] = r
170	        if f.get("reread_disagrees"):
171	            it["reread_disagrees"] = True
172	            rv = (f.get("reread") or {}).get("value")
173	            if rv is not None:
174	                it["reread_value"] = rv
175	        it["sums"] = []
176	        for s in f.get("sums") or []:
177	            d = {"kind": s["kind"], "name": s["name"]}
178	            for k, v in (("label", s.get("printed_label")), ("printed", s.get("printed")),
179	                         ("with_file", s.get("computed_with_file")), ("with_scan", s.get("computed_with_scan")),
180	                         ("holds_file", s.get("holds_with_file")), ("holds_scan", s.get("holds_with_scan"))):
181	                if v is not None:
182	                    d[k] = v
183	            d["terms"] = [[index.get((t["cell"][0], t["cell"][1], t["cell"][2], str(t["cell"][3]))), t["value"]]
184	                          for t in s.get("terms") or []]
185	            it["sums"].append(d)
186	        if f.get("confirmed_by_person"):
187	            it["confirmed_by_person"] = True
188	        items.append(it)
189	
190	    groups = []
191	    for g in doc.get("groups") or []:
192	        d = {"id": g["id"], "kind": g["kind"], "findings": list(g.get("findings") or [])}
193	        for k, v in (("office", g.get("office")), ("row", label(g.get("block"), g)), ("precincts", g.get("precincts")),
194	                     ("page", g.get("page")), ("block", g.get("block")),
195	                     ("crop", crop_path(county, g["id"], g.get("crop")))):
196	            if v not in (None, "", []):
197	                d[k] = v
198	        groups.append(d)
199	
200	    counts = dict(doc.get("counts") or {})
201	    counts["confirmed"] = sum(1 for f in doc["findings"] if f.get("confirmed_by_person"))
202	    fd = {"run": doc.get("run_id") or raw["run_id"], "counts": counts, "groups": groups, "items": items}
203	    if path:
204	        fd["path"] = path
205	    if evidence:
206	        fd["evidence"] = evidence
207	    if doc.get("sums_check"):
208	        fd["sums_check"] = doc["sums_check"]
209	
210	    cells = raw["cells"]
211	    fig = {"cells": len(cells),
212	           "right_first": sum(1 for c in cells if c["status"] == "accepted" and not c.get("tries")),
213	           "right_after": sum(1 for c in cells if c["status"] == "accepted" and c.get("tries")),
214	           "disagreements": len(items),
215	           "settled": sum(1 for i in items if i["status"] == "settled_against_file")}
216	    rr = (raw.get("summary") or {}).get("cells_reread")
217	    if rr is not None:
218	        fig["reread"] = rr
219	    fd["figures"] = fig
220	    if run:
221	        info = {k: run[k] for k in ("reader", "sample", "seconds", "phases_seconds", "model_calls_by_model",
222	                                    "metered_cost_estimate", "resumed_from", "seconds_total") if run.get(k) is not None}
223	        if info:
224	            fd["run_info"] = info
225	    return fd

228	def build_county(raw: dict, sizes: dict, img_path=lambda county, n: f"data/pages/{county}-p{n}.webp",
229	                 block_path=lambda county, bid: f"data/blocks/{county}-{bid}.webp", ink=None, rules=None,
230	                 findings=None, run=None, findings_path=None, evidence=None,
231	                 crop_path=lambda county, gid, src: None) -> dict:
232	    """The county's JSON for the page. `sizes` maps page number -> (render_w, render_h, img_w, img_h);
233	    `ink` maps (page, block, row, column) -> ink box in block-image pixels, `rules` maps (page, block) -> the y of
234	    the ruled line above the block's first row (see render_blocks); `findings` is the county's findings.json, `run`
235	    the run's run.json."""
236	    ink, rules = ink or {}, rules or {}
237	    county = raw["county"]
238	    pages, sc_of, frame_of = [], {}, {}
239	    for pg in raw["pages"]:
240	        n = pg["number"]
241	        if n not in sizes:
242	            raise ValueError(f"page {n} of {county} has no rendered size")
243	        rw, rh, iw, ih = sizes[n]
244	        # the boxes live in the frame of the recorded size when there is one, else of the render
245	        frame_w = pg.get("width") or rw
246	        sc = iw / frame_w
247	        sc_of[n] = sc
248	        frame_of[n] = (frame_w, rw)
249	        pages.append({"n": n, "img": img_path(county, n), "w": iw, "h": ih, "sc": round(sc, 6)})
250	
251	    values, index = [], {}
252	
253	    def add(p, b, r, c, v, box, **extra):
254	        if (p, b, r, c) in index:
255	            raise ValueError(f"value {p}:{b}:{r}:{c} appears twice in {county}")
256	        index[(p, b, r, c)] = len(values)
257	        d = {"p": p, "b": b, "r": r, "c": c, "v": v, "x": _scale_box(box, sc_of.get(p, 1.0)),
258	             "ix": ink.get((p, b, r, c))}
259	        d.update(extra)
260	        values.append(d)
261	
262	    for c in raw["cells"]:
263	        add(c["page"], c["block"], c["row_kind"], str(c["column"]), c["value"], c.get("box"),
264	            s=c["status"], m=c.get("model"), n=c.get("tries"))
265	    for t in raw["totals"]:
266	        add(t["page"], t["block"], t["direction"], str(t["key"]), t["value"], t.get("box"))
267	
268	    checks = []
269	    for ch in raw["checks"]:
270	        refs = []
271	        for term in ch["terms"]:
272	            p, b, r, c = term if len(term) == 4 and not isinstance(term[0], list) else term[0]   # a key, or [key, value]
273	            k = (p, b, r, str(c))
274	            if k not in index:
275	                raise ValueError(f"check {ch['kind']} {ch['page']}:{ch['block']}:{ch['key']} names a term "
276	                                 f"{p}:{b}:{r}:{c} that is not a value")
277	            refs.append(index[k])
278	        checks.append({"k": "grand" if ch["kind"] == "grand_col" else ch["kind"], "p": ch["page"], "b": ch["block"], "y": str(ch["key"]), "ok": bool(ch["ok"]),
279	                       "pr": ch["printed"], "co": ch["computed"], "t": refs})
280	
281	    blocks = []
282	    for b in raw["blocks"]:
283	        box = b.get("box")
284	        ok = _scale_box(box, 1.0) is not None and b["page"] in frame_of
285	        bi = None
286	        if ok:
287	            _, _, w, h = block_geometry(box, *frame_of[b["page"]])
288	            bi = {"img": block_path(county, b["id"]), "w": w, "h": h, "rt": rules.get((b["page"], b["id"]))}
289	        blocks.append({"id": b["id"], "p": b["page"], "contest": b["contest"], "cand": b.get("candidate"),
290	                       "x": _scale_box(box, sc_of.get(b["page"], 1.0)), "bi": bi})
291	    out = {"county": county, "run": raw["run_id"], "layout": raw["layout"], "pages": pages, "blocks": blocks,
292	           "values": values, "checks": checks,
293	           "events": [{"t": e["ts"], "k": e["kind"], "p": e["payload"]} for e in raw["events"]]}
294	    vd = [{"s": v.get("sum"), "v": v.get("verdict"), "r": v.get("reason"), "e": v.get("entity")}
295	          for v in raw.get("verdicts") or [] if isinstance(v, dict)]
296	    if vd:
297	        out["vd"] = vd
298	    sm = {k: raw["summary"][k] for k in ("sums_failing_before", "sums_failing_after", "items_worked", "cells_reread")
299	          if (raw.get("summary") or {}).get(k) is not None}
300	    if sm:
301	        out["sm"] = sm
302	    if findings:
303	        out["fd"] = build_findings(raw, index, findings, run, findings_path, evidence, crop_path)
304	    return out

307	def render_pages(county: str, page_numbers, out_dir: Path, data_root=None, max_width=MAX_WIDTH) -> dict:
308	    """Renders each page at 200 dpi (cached by crossfoot.render), saves a WebP at most max_width wide."""
309	    from PIL import Image
310	    from .render import page_png
311	    from .sources import DATA
312	    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
313	    sizes = {}
314	    for n in page_numbers:
315	        with Image.open(page_png(county, n, RENDER_DPI, data_root or DATA)) as im:
316	            rw, rh = im.size
317	            iw = min(max_width, rw)
318	            ih = round(rh * iw / rw)
319	            im.convert("L").resize((iw, ih), Image.LANCZOS).save(out_dir / f"{county}-p{n}.webp", quality=88, method=6)
320	        sizes[n] = (rw, rh, iw, ih)
321	    return sizes

324	def render_blocks(raw: dict, sizes: dict, out_dir: Path, data_root=None) -> dict:
325	    """Cuts every block that has a box out of its page at 300 dpi and saves it as a grey WebP.
326	    Returns (inks, rules): the ink box of every value that has one, {(page, block, row, column): [x0, y0, x1, y1]},
327	    and the y of the ruled line above each block's first row, {(page, block): y}, both in the pixels of the
328	    block's image."""
329	    from PIL import Image
330	    from .render import page_png
331	    from .sources import DATA
332	    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
333	    county, inks, rules = raw["county"], {}, {}
334	    frames = {pg["number"]: (pg.get("width") or sizes[pg["number"]][0], sizes[pg["number"]][0]) for pg in raw["pages"]}
335	    for n in sorted({b["page"] for b in raw["blocks"] if b.get("box")}):
336	        with Image.open(page_png(county, n, BLOCK_DPI, data_root or DATA)) as im:
337	            im = im.convert("L")
338	            for b in raw["blocks"]:
339	                if b["page"] != n or not _scale_box(b.get("box"), 1.0):
340	                    continue
341	                geom = block_geometry(b["box"], *frames[n])
342	                cut = cut_block(im, geom)
343	                cut.save(out_dir / f"{county}-{b['id']}.webp", quality=82, method=6)
344	                k = frames[n][1] * BLOCK_DPI / RENDER_DPI / frames[n][0]
345	                left = max(0, min(geom[0], im.width - geom[2]))
346	                top = max(0, min(geom[1], im.height - geom[3]))
347	                first = None
348	                for rows, rk, ck in ((raw["cells"], "row_kind", "column"), (raw["totals"], "direction", "key")):
349	                    for o in rows:
350	                        if o["page"] != n or o["block"] != b["id"] or not _scale_box(o.get("box"), 1.0):
351	                            continue
352	                        cb = [o["box"][0] * k - left, o["box"][1] * k - top, o["box"][2] * k - left, o["box"][3] * k - top]
353	                        if rk == "row_kind" and (first is None or cb[1] < first[1]):
354	                            first = cb
355	                        ib = ink_box(cut, cb)
356	                        if ib:
357	                            inks[(n, b["id"], o[rk], str(o[ck]))] = ib
358	                rt = rule_top(cut, first) if first else None
359	                if rt is not None:
360	                    rules[(n, b["id"])] = rt
361	    return inks, rules

364	def total_seconds(meta: dict, runs_dir="runs"):
365	    """This run's seconds plus those of every run it resumed (`resumed_from`, followed back); None when the run, or
366	    one it resumed, did not record its seconds or its run.json cannot be found."""
367	    total, seen = 0.0, set()
368	    while meta:
369	        if not isinstance(meta.get("seconds"), (int, float)):
370	            return None
371	        total += meta["seconds"]
372	        prior = meta.get("resumed_from")
373	        if not prior:
374	            return round(total, 1)
375	        if prior in seen:
376	            return None
377	        seen.add(prior)
378	        path = Path(runs_dir) / str(prior) / "run.json"
379	        meta = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.exists() else None
380	    return None

384	    """The newest run that has a findings.json."""
385	    ids = sorted(p.parent.parent.name for p in Path(runs_dir).glob("*/*/findings.json"))

391	def build(run_id: str, runs_dir="runs", out="site/data", counties=None, data_root=None) -> list[str]:
392	    if run_id == "latest":
393	        run_id = latest_run(runs_dir)
394	    run_dir = Path(runs_dir) / run_id
395	    out = Path(out)
396	    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
397	    meta = json.loads((run_dir / "run.json").read_text()) if (run_dir / "run.json").exists() else {}
398	    if meta.get("resumed_from"):

405	    index = {"run": run_id, "started": meta.get("started"), "ended": meta.get("ended"), "counties": [], "summary": {},
406	             "run_totals": {k: meta[k] for k in ("model_calls", "prompt_tokens", "completion_tokens",
407	                                                 "metered_cost_estimate") if k in meta}}
408	    for key in keys:

"""Report layout (San Saba, Cottle and others): one precinct per section, one row per candidate with four numbers.

Reading: the county's layout is decided from its first page (`profile.decide_layout`); the first page is read under that
decision and the decision is thrown away if more than a third of its row sums fail. The same sample chooses the reader
(`profile.decide`). One page per model call at 200 dpi, strict JSON, one repair request.

The ledger: a cell is (page, block, row, column). A block is one contest on one precinct, `block_id` "<precinct key>|<n>"
(a contest that runs over a page break is one block: its cells carry different pages and the same block id); the Statistics
rows "Ballots Cast - Total" and "Ballots Cast - Blank" are blocks of their own, named as the published file names them.
`row_kind` is the row's label as printed, `column` is total | absentee | early | election_day. A cell's box is the row's
strip of the page at 200 dpi ([0, y - 20, x_right, y + 20]; y is the model's own estimate, so the box is approximate and
re-read crops are cut with generous padding).

Checks (`checks.report_checks`): each row's total = absentee + early voting + election day; where a contest prints a total
row ("Total Votes Cast", "Cast Votes"), the candidates' figures in a column add to that row's figure in the column. A value
sits on its row's own sum, and, only where the page prints a contest total, on the column's sum too.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import subprocess
import time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image

from .. import agent, checks, tracing
from ..model import BudgetExceeded
from ..render import page_png
from . import profile

COLS = checks.REPORT_COLS
HALF_ROW = 20          # half the height of a row's box, pixels at 200 dpi
ROW_PAD = 100          # a re-read crop reaches this far above and below the row's centre, pixels at 200 dpi
GEO_DPI = 200
PARALLEL = 3           # model calls in flight while a county's pages are read
MAX_ACTIONS = agent.MAX_ACTIONS
NOTE_NO_TOTALS = "nothing on this scan can be cross-checked; left as published"


# ---- names: both sides are normalised before they are compared ---------------------------------------------------------

def precinct_key(name) -> str:
    """"PRECINCT 101", "Precinct 101" and "101" are one precinct; so are "Precinct 2A", "2A" and "02a"."""
    s = re.sub(r"\b(?:precinct|pct)\b", " ", str(name or ""), flags=re.I)
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", s.lower())
    return re.sub(r"^0+(?=\d)", "", s)


def contest_canon(label) -> str:
    """A contest's name with the scan's and the file's spellings made one: "Pl 2" = "PI 2", "Dist" = "District" (the word
    is dropped on both sides)."""
    s = re.sub(r"\b(?:district|dist)\b", " ", str(label or "").lower())
    s = re.sub(r"\bp[il](?=\s*\d)", "pl", s)
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", s)


_PARTY = re.compile(r"^(REP|DEM|LIB|GRN|IND|NPA|UNA|NON)\s+(.+)$")
_WRITE_IN = ("writeintotals", "writeintotal", "writeins", "writein")


def split_label(label) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """(party, name) of a row label as printed: "REP Donald J. Trump/JD Vance" -> ("REP", "Donald J. Trump"). A write-in
    row is "Write-ins" as the published file names it."""
    s = " ".join(str(label or "").split())
    if re.sub(r"[^a-z]", "", s.lower()) in _WRITE_IN:
        return "", "Write-ins"
    m = _PARTY.match(s)
    party, rest = (m.group(1), m.group(2)) if m else ("", s)
    return party, rest.split("/")[0].strip()

"""Page rendering with pdftoppm, and crops with Pillow."""
from __future__ import annotations

import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image

from .sources import DATA, scan_path


class RenderError(Exception):
    pass


def page_png(key: str, page: int, dpi: int = 200, root: Path = DATA) -> Path:
    """Render one page (1-based) of a county's scan to data/pages/<key>/pNN-<dpi>.png; cached."""
    out = root / "pages" / key / f"p{page:02d}-{dpi}.png"
    if out.exists():
        return out
    if shutil.which("pdftoppm") is None:
        raise RenderError("pdftoppm is not installed; install poppler-utils (apt install poppler-utils)")
    pdf = scan_path(key, root)
    if not pdf.exists():
        raise RenderError(f"{pdf} is missing; run `crossfoot fetch --county {key}` first")
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    r = subprocess.run(["pdftoppm", "-png", "-r", str(dpi), "-f", str(page), "-l", str(page),
                        "-singlefile", str(pdf), str(out.with_suffix(""))],
                       capture_output=True, text=True)
    if r.returncode != 0 or not out.exists():
        raise RenderError(f"pdftoppm failed for {pdf} page {page}: {r.stderr.strip()}")
    return out


def crop(png: Path, box: tuple[int, int, int, int], dest: Path) -> Path:
    """Crop (x0, y0, x1, y1) out of an image and save it."""
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with Image.open(png) as im:
        im.crop(box).save(dest)
    return dest

import pytest

from crossfoot.sitebuild import build_county


def raw():
    cell = lambda r, c, v, box: {"page": 1, "block": "b1", "contest": "X", "candidate": "A", "row_kind": r,
                                 "column": c, "value": v, "first_read": v, "status": "accepted", "tries": 0,
                                 "model": "m", "reason": None, "box": box}
    tot = lambda d, k, v, box: {"page": 1, "block": "b1", "direction": d, "key": k, "value": v, "box": box}
    ref = lambda r, c: [1, "b1", r, c]
    return {
        "county": "tiny", "run_id": "r1", "layout": "matrix",
        "pages": [{"number": 1, "width": 2000, "height": 1000, "dpi": 200}],
        "blocks": [{"id": "b1", "page": 1, "contest": "X", "candidate": "A", "box": [100, 100, 1900, 500]}],
        "cells": [cell("A", "1", 1, [200, 200, 300, 250]), cell("A", "2", 2, None),
                  cell("B", "1", 4, [200, 250, 300, 300]), cell("B", "2", 5, [300, 250, 400, 300])],
        "totals": [tot("row", "A", 3, [1800, 200, 1900, 250]), tot("col", "1", 5, [200, 300, 300, 350]),
                   tot("grand", "", 9, [1800, 300, 1900, 350])],
        "checks": [
            {"kind": "row", "page": 1, "block": "b1", "key": "A", "terms": [[ref("A", "1"), 1], [ref("A", "2"), 2]],
             "printed": 3, "computed": 3, "ok": True},
            {"kind": "col", "page": 1, "block": "b1", "key": "1", "terms": [[ref("A", "1"), 1], [ref("B", "1"), 4]],
             "printed": 5, "computed": 5, "ok": True},
            {"kind": "grand", "page": 1, "block": "b1", "key": "", "terms": [[ref("col", "1"), 5]],
             "printed": 9, "computed": 5, "ok": False}],
        "events": [{"ts": 1.5, "kind": "check", "payload": {"a": 1}}], "summary": {}}


def test_terms_resolve_to_values():
    d = build_county(raw(), {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)})
    for ch in d["checks"]:
        for i in ch["t"]:
            v = d["values"][i]
            assert (v["p"], v["b"]) == (ch["p"], ch["b"])
    row = d["checks"][0]
    assert [d["values"][i]["v"] for i in row["t"]] == [1, 2]
    assert d["values"][d["checks"][2]["t"][0]]["r"] == "col"


def test_boxes_are_scaled_and_missing_stays_null():
    d = build_county(raw(), {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)})
    assert d["pages"][0]["sc"] == 0.5 and d["pages"][0]["w"] == 1000
    v = {(x["r"], x["c"]): x for x in d["values"]}
    assert v[("A", "1")]["x"] == [100.0, 100.0, 150.0, 125.0]
    assert v[("A", "2")]["x"] is None
    assert d["blocks"][0]["x"] == [50.0, 50.0, 950.0, 250.0]
    assert all(x["x"] is None or any(x["x"]) for x in d["values"])


def test_unresolved_term_is_an_error():
    r = raw()
    r["checks"][0]["terms"][0][0] = [1, "b1", "Z", "9"]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        build_county(r, {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)})


def test_every_block_has_a_300_dpi_image_the_size_of_its_box():
    from crossfoot.sitebuild import block_geometry, cut_block
    from PIL import Image
    d = build_county(raw(), {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)})
    b = d["blocks"][0]
    # the box is 1800 x 400 px at 200 dpi, so 2700 x 600 at 300 dpi
    assert abs(b["bi"]["w"] - 2700) <= 1 and abs(b["bi"]["h"] - 600) <= 1
    assert b["bi"]["img"].endswith("tiny-b1.webp")
    # the cut has exactly that size, also when the box touches the page edge
    page = Image.new("L", (3000, 1500), 255)
    assert cut_block(page, block_geometry([100, 100, 1900, 500], 2000, 2000)).size == (b["bi"]["w"], b["bi"]["h"])
    assert cut_block(page, block_geometry([200, 100, 2000, 500], 2000, 2000)).size == (2700, 600)


def test_block_without_a_box_has_no_image():
    r = raw()
    r["blocks"][0]["box"] = None
    assert build_county(r, {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)})["blocks"][0]["bi"] is None


def test_ink_box_finds_a_figure_printed_low_and_right_in_a_ruled_cell():
    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
    from crossfoot.sitebuild import ink_box
    im = Image.new("L", (200, 100), 255)
    dr = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    dr.rectangle([10, 10, 109, 59], outline=0, width=2)        # the ruled cell
    dr.rectangle([70, 38, 100, 52], fill=0)                    # the figure: low and right
    assert ink_box(im, [10, 10, 110, 60]) == [70, 38, 101, 53]
    # a zero is ink
    dr.rectangle([70, 38, 100, 52], fill=255)
    dr.ellipse([80, 40, 98, 52], outline=0, width=2)
    assert ink_box(im, [10, 10, 110, 60]) is not None


def test_ink_box_of_an_empty_ruled_cell_is_none():
    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
    from crossfoot.sitebuild import ink_box
    im = Image.new("L", (200, 100), 255)
    ImageDraw.Draw(im).rectangle([10, 10, 109, 59], outline=0, width=2)
    assert ink_box(im, [10, 10, 110, 60]) is None
    assert ink_box(im, [10, 10, 12, 12]) is None


def test_values_carry_their_ink_box():
    d = build_county(raw(), {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)}, ink={(1, "b1", "A", "1"): [5, 6, 20, 30]})
    v = {(x["r"], x["c"]): x for x in d["values"]}
    assert v[("A", "1")]["ix"] == [5, 6, 20, 30] and v[("B", "1")]["ix"] is None


def test_rule_top_finds_the_ruled_line_above_a_row():
    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
    from crossfoot.sitebuild import rule_top
    im = Image.new("L", (300, 120), 255)
    ImageDraw.Draw(im).rectangle([0, 40, 299, 43], fill=0)
    assert rule_top(im, [20, 44, 120, 90]) == 40
    assert rule_top(im, [20, 100, 120, 119]) is None


def findings_doc():
    ref = lambda r, c: [1, "b1", r, c]
    sums = [{"name": "the cells of precinct 1 add to the small total", "kind": "col", "page": 1, "block": "b1",
             "terms": [{"cell": ref("A", "1"), "value": 1}, {"cell": ref("B", "1"), "value": 4}], "printed": 5,
             "printed_label": "small total printed under the column", "computed_with_scan": 5, "holds_with_scan": True,
             "computed_with_file": 4, "holds_with_file": False}]
    f = lambda i, **kw: {"id": i, "group": "g1", "county": "tiny", "office": "X", "district": "", "party": "",
                         "candidate": "A", "precinct": "1", "part": "early_voting", "file_value": 0, "scan_value": 1,
                         "kind": "wrong_column", "status": "settled_against_file", "reason": "r", "sums": sums,
                         "page": 1, "block": "b1", "box": [200, 200, 300, 250], "crop": "crops/g1.png",
                         "reread": None, "confirmed_by_person": False, **kw}
    return {"county": "tiny", "run_id": "r1", "file": "x.csv",
            "counts": {"findings": 2, "by_kind": {"wrong_column": 2}, "by_status": {"settled_against_file": 2},
                       "groups": 1, "corrections": 1},
            "findings": [f("f1"), f("f2", part="votes", precinct="9", box=[1, 1, 2, 2], file_value=None,
                               reread={"value": 7}, reread_disagrees=True)],
            "groups": [{"id": "g1", "kind": "wrong_column", "office": "X", "district": "", "candidate": "A",
                        "precincts": ["1"], "page": 1, "block": "b1", "findings": ["f1", "f2"], "crop": "crops/g1.png"}]}


def test_findings_resolve_to_values_and_leave_out_what_is_missing():
    run = {"reader": "m1", "seconds": 60.0, "sample": {"row_sums": 22, "failing": 6, "sampled_with": "m0"}}
    d = build_county(raw(), {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)}, findings=findings_doc(), run=run,

    assert [d["values"][t[0]]["v"] for t in f1["sums"][0]["terms"]] == [1, 4]

    seen, out = set(), {}

    for v in out.values():

    return out

    have = {(c["page"], c["block"], c["row_kind"]) for c in raw["cells"] if c.get("box")}

            items.add(p["item"])
            add(p["page"], p["block"], p["row"])
    from .checks import row_label_kind
    blocks = {b for _, b, _ in crops}

BASE = f"http://127.0.0.1:{srv.server_address[1]}/"

    ctx = b.new_context(viewport={"width": w, "height": h}, **kw); pg = ctx.new_page()

    pg.on("console", lambda m: errs.append(m.text) if m.type == "error" else None)

# ---- the report layout (T07c): row crops, figures from the ink, the run's index --------------------------------------------

def page_image():
    """A made-up portrait page at 300 dpi: a contest heading, column headings, six rows of a label and four figures."""
    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
    im = Image.new("L", (1000, 1400), 255)
    dr = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    dr.rectangle([40, 100, 400, 140], fill=0)                       # the contest's title
    dr.rectangle([40, 150, 160, 168], fill=0)                       # "Vote For 1"
    for x in (520, 660, 800, 930):
        dr.rectangle([x - 40, 200, x + 20, 230], fill=0)            # the column headings
    figs = {}
    for r in range(6):
        y = 300 + r * 80                                            # a row pitch of 80 px, the figures 24 px tall
        dr.rectangle([40, y, 300, y + 24], fill=0)                  # the label
        for c, x in enumerate((520, 660, 800, 930)):
            dr.rectangle([x - 10 * (c + 1), y, x + 10, y + 24], fill=0)
            figs[(r, c)] = [x - 10 * (c + 1), y, x + 11, y + 25]
        dr.line([40, y + 38, 960, y + 38], fill=200, width=1)       # a dotted rule is a faint line
    return im, figs


def test_the_heading_starts_after_the_blank_band_above_it():
    from crossfoot.sitebuild import heading_top, _dark
    im, _ = page_image()
    dark, _ = _dark(im, [0, 0, 1000, 1400])
    ink = dark.sum(axis=1) >= 3
    assert heading_top(ink, 295) == 100                              # the title's first row, not the paper above it
    assert heading_top([False] * 400, 300) == 130                    # nothing found: a fixed reach above the row


def test_a_deep_row_gets_the_heading_and_its_own_neighbourhood_as_two_pieces():
    from crossfoot.sitebuild import row_pieces, cut_pieces, to_crop, to_page, _dark, SPACER
    im, _ = page_image()
    dark, _ = _dark(im, [0, 0, 1000, 1400])
    ink = dark.sum(axis=1) >= 3
    strips = [(290 + r * 80, 335 + r * 80) for r in range(6)]
    top = row_pieces(strips, 0, ink)
    assert len(top) == 1 and top[0][0] == 100                        # a row near the top: heading and rows in one piece
    deep = row_pieces(strips, 5, ink)
    assert len(deep) == 2 and deep[0][1] <= 300                      # the heading ends above the first row
    assert deep[1][0] >= 480 and deep[1][1] <= 1400                  # two rows above the row, none below (it is the last)
    crop, parts = cut_pieces(im, deep, 960)
    assert crop.height == sum(b - a for a, b in deep) + SPACER
    # nothing is drawn into the crop: every pixel of it is a pixel of the page, or white
    assert to_page(parts, 50, to_crop(parts, 50, 700)[1]) == (50, 700)
    assert to_crop(parts, 5, 5) is None
    band = crop.crop((0, parts[0][1] - parts[0][0], 960, parts[0][1] - parts[0][0] + SPACER))
    assert band.getextrema() == (255, 255)


def test_figures_are_found_from_the_ink_right_to_left_and_a_wrong_count_gives_none():
    from crossfoot.sitebuild import figure_boxes, COLS
    im, figs = page_image()
    vals = {"total": 1234, "absentee": 12, "early": 345, "election_day": 6}
    boxes, label, h = figure_boxes(im, [0, 295, 960, 335], values={c: vals[c] for c in COLS})
    # the ink gives each figure's box (within the strip shrunk by 6 px each side): the figure is 25 px tall
    for c, col in enumerate(COLS):
        b, want = boxes[col], figs[(0, c)]
        assert b is not None and abs(b[0] - want[0]) <= 1 and abs(b[2] - want[2]) <= 1 and abs(b[1] - want[1]) <= 1
    assert label is not None and label[0] == 40 and h == 25
    # a row with fewer clusters than columns: nothing is guessed
    empty, lab, hh = figure_boxes(im, [0, 220, 960, 240], values=None)
    assert all(v is None for v in empty.values()) and lab is None and hh is None
    # widths that do not fit the digits of the values (a 4-digit value that is as wide as a 1-digit one) are not trusted
    odd = figure_boxes(im, [0, 295, 960, 335], values={"total": 1, "absentee": 1234567, "early": 1, "election_day": 1})
    assert all(v is None for v in odd[0].values())


def report_raw():
    cell = lambda r, c, v, y: {"page": 1, "block": "1|1", "contest": "President", "candidate": "A", "row_kind": r, "column": c,
                               "value": v, "first_read": v, "status": "accepted", "tries": 0, "model": "m", "reason": None,
                               "box": [0, y, 950, y + 40]}
    rows = [("A", [10, 1, 4, 5], 100), ("B", [6, 0, 2, 4], 140), ("Total Votes Cast", [16, 1, 6, 9], 180)]
    cells = [cell(r, c, v, y) for r, vs, y in rows for c, v in zip(("total", "absentee", "early", "election_day"), vs)]
    checks = [{"kind": "report_row", "page": 1, "block": "1|1", "key": r, "terms": [[1, "1|1", r, c] for c in ("absentee", "early", "election_day")],
               "printed": vs[0], "computed": sum(vs[1:]), "ok": True} for r, vs, y in rows]
    checks.append({"kind": "report_contest", "page": 1, "block": "1|1", "key": "total",
                   "terms": [[1, "1|1", "A", "total"], [1, "1|1", "B", "total"]], "printed": 16, "computed": 16, "ok": True})
    return {"county": "tiny", "run_id": "r1", "layout": "report", "pages": [{"number": 1, "width": 1000, "height": 1400, "dpi": 200}],
            "blocks": [{"id": "1|1", "page": 1, "contest": "President", "candidate": "A", "box": None}], "cells": cells,
            "totals": [], "checks": checks, "events": [], "summary": {}}


def report_findings():
    sums = [{"name": "the row adds up", "kind": "report_row", "page": 1, "block": "1|1", "printed": 10, "printed_label": "total",
             "terms": [{"cell": [1, "1|1", "A", c], "value": v} for c, v in (("absentee", 1), ("early", 4), ("election_day", 5))],
             "computed_with_scan": 10, "holds_with_scan": True, "computed_with_file": 11, "holds_with_file": False},
            {"name": "the column adds up", "kind": "report_contest", "page": 1, "block": "1|1", "printed": 16, "printed_label": "contest total",
             "terms": [{"cell": [1, "1|1", "A", "total"], "value": 10}, {"cell": [1, "1|1", "B", "total"], "value": 6}],
             "computed_with_scan": 16, "holds_with_scan": True, "computed_with_file": 17, "holds_with_file": False}]
    f = lambda i, part, fv, sv, **kw: {"id": i, "group": "g1", "county": "tiny", "office": "President", "party": "", "candidate": "A",
                                       "precinct": "Precinct 2", "part": part, "file_value": fv, "scan_value": sv, "kind": "wrong_number",
                                       "status": "settled_against_file", "reason": "r", "sums": sums, "page": 1, "block": "1|1", "row": "A",
                                       "box": [0, 100, 950, 140], "crop": None, "reread": None, "confirmed_by_person": False, **kw}
    return {"county": "tiny", "run_id": "r1", "file": "x.csv",
            "counts": {"findings": 2, "by_kind": {"wrong_number": 2}, "by_status": {"settled_against_file": 2}, "groups": 1},
            "findings": [f("f1", "absentee", 0, 1), f("f2", "early_voting", 5, 4, status="cannot_verify",
                                                      reread={"value": 4, "agrees_with_ledger": True, "error": None})],
            "groups": [{"id": "g1", "kind": "wrong_number", "office": "President", "district": "", "candidate": "A", "precincts": ["Precinct 2"],
                        "page": 1, "block": "1|1", "findings": ["f1", "f2"], "crop": None}]}


def test_a_report_finding_sits_on_its_figure_and_carries_the_rows_both_readings():
    d = build_county(report_raw(), {1: (1000, 1400, 1000, 1400)}, findings=report_findings(),
                     rows={"rc": [{"id": 0, "p": 1, "b": "1|1", "r": "A"}], "fx": {(1, "1|1", "A", "absentee"): [1, 2, 3, 4]},
                           "rcix": {(1, "1|1", "A"): 0}})
    v = {(x["r"], x["c"]): i for i, x in enumerate(d["values"])}
    f1, f2 = d["fd"]["items"]
    assert f1["ref"] == v[("A", "absentee")] and f2["ref"] == v[("A", "early")]
    assert f1["col"] == "absentee" and f2["col"] == "early" and f1["rc"] == 0
    # the row is the label as printed on the scan, not the block's first row
    assert f1["row"] == "A" and d["fd"]["groups"][0]["row"] == "A"
    # both findings are on one row: the file's row has both of the file's values
    assert f1["rv"] == {"file": [10, 0, 5, 5], "scan": [10, 1, 4, 5]} and f2["rv"] == f1["rv"]
    # the contest total row's value in the figure's column
    assert d["values"][f1["tot"]]["r"] == "Total Votes Cast" and d["values"][f1["tot"]]["c"] == "absentee"
    assert f2["reread_agrees"] is True and "reread_agrees" not in f1
    assert d["values"][f1["ref"]]["fx"] == [1, 2, 3, 4] and "fx" not in d["values"][v[("B", "total")]]
    assert d["rc"][0]["id"] == 0


def test_a_page_without_an_image_is_listed_with_its_number_and_size():
    from crossfoot.sitebuild import frame_sizes
    raw = report_raw()
    assert frame_sizes(raw) == {1: (1000, 1400, 1000, 1400)}
    raw["pages"].append({"number": 2, "width": 2400, "height": 3000, "dpi": 200})
    sizes = frame_sizes(raw)
    assert sizes[2] == (2400, 3000, 1600, 2000)
    d = build_county(raw, sizes, images={1})
    assert [p["img"] is None for p in d["pages"]] == [False, True] and d["pages"][1]["w"] == 1600


def test_the_rows_that_need_a_crop_are_the_rows_with_a_finding_and_the_rows_read_again():
    from crossfoot.sitebuild import wanted_rows
    raw = report_raw()
    raw["events"] = [{"ts": 1, "kind": "reread", "payload": {"item": "i1", "page": 1, "block": "1|1", "row": "B"}},
                     {"ts": 2, "kind": "reread", "payload": {"item": "i1", "page": 1, "block": "1|1", "row": "A"}}]
    crops, tots = wanted_rows(raw, report_findings())
    assert crops == [(1, "1|1", "A"), (1, "1|1", "B")]               # A for its findings, B for the first re-read of the item
    assert tots == [(1, "1|1", "Total Votes Cast")]                  # the contest total row only needs its figures

                               tmp_path, lambda county, n: f"data/rows/{county}-r{n}.webp")

import sys, subprocess, shutil, http.server, socketserver, threading, functools, pathlib
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
from PIL import Image, ImageChops

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
S = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); shutil.rmtree(S / "A", ignore_errors=True); shutil.rmtree(S / "B", ignore_errors=True)
(S / "A").mkdir(parents=True); (S / "B").mkdir(parents=True)
subprocess.run(f"git archive 1809cb8 site | tar -x -C {S / 'A'}", shell=True, check=True, cwd=ROOT)
shutil.copytree(ROOT / "site", S / "B" / "site"); shutil.rmtree(S / "B" / "site" / "data"); shutil.copytree(S / "A" / "site" / "data", S / "B" / "site" / "data")

def serve(d):
    srv = socketserver.TCPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), functools.partial(Q, directory=str(d))); threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()

STATUS: DONE_WITH_CONCERNS

COMMITS: 1809cb8..082d4d0 — T07c: every county on the page: county tabs, the run line, the report layout's row crops and figures found from the ink. Committed only, nothing pushed.

FILES: 197 files changed, 19,617 insertions, 1,039 deletions. The raw `git diff --stat` is the first block of `.prod-build/reports/T07c.md`. The changes are in `crossfoot/sitebuild.py`, `tests/test_sitebuild.py`, `site/` (new `tabs.js`; edits to `app.js`, `data.js`, `findings.js`, `loupe.js`, `panel.js`, `replay.js`, `stage.js`, `tape.js`, `styles.css`, `index.html`; rebuilt `data/`) and `qa/t07c/`.

EVIDENCE: no ledger, since `pb.py` is not usable in this worktree.
- **Tests:** `uv run pytest -q` gives 186 passed (177 before, 9 new).
- **Build:** `uv run python -m crossfoot.sitebuild --run 20261011-130414` writes 8 county entries and 7 county files. Limestone is listed with its reason and has no file. `site/data/` weighs 15,196,033 bytes, under the 25 MB limit. Of the report counties' 143 pages, 29 have an image.
- **Run totals** (`index.json`): 8 counties, 7 read, 228 disagreements, 168 settled, 60 cannot verify, 0 confirmed. 4,839 printed sums: 4,737 hold with the published files, 4,803 with the corrected.
- **Row crops:** 62 crops in all. All four figures were found from the ink in 54 of them and none in 8. 78 of the 90 findings that sit on the sheet are on a figure the ink gave; the other 12 fall back to the row.
- **Panola unchanged:** I opened the commit before this task and the new code, both with the old data. At 1440×900, 0 of 1,296,000 pixels differ by more than 30 (of 765). At 390×844, 0 of 329,160 do. The numbers on screen differ only because the new run says 109 settled and 12 cannot verify, where T07b's run said 110 and 11.
- **Accessibility:** axe reports 0 violations in 22 runs (`qa/t07c/axe.json`): 11 states at both sizes, including tabs with keyboard focus and a paused San Saba replay.
- **Replay timelines:** `qa/t07c/timeline.mjs` builds them for San Saba (27 steps, 25 s), Jones (44 steps, 43 s), Lynn and Cottle with no failures, and the Panola one still passes. I played whole replays of San Saba, Cottle and Jones in the browser with no errors.
- **Screenshots:** under `qa/t07c/`. I opened all of them and fixed what was off, including loupe windows cutting headings or figures, a tag over other figures, and a sheet running over the caption.

RULINGS (full list in the report):
- Row crops run from the contest heading to the row plus two rows of context. A row deeper than the second gets two pieces, the heading and then the row with its neighbours, with a white spacer between; `parts` in the data records exactly which pieces of the page they are.
- The opening finding of a report county is its first finding, per the brief. Panola keeps the T07b rule.
- The "Both rows add up…" sentence is used only when the finding's own row sums hold with both values.
- Panola's numbers and a report county's seconds, cost and reader now come from the county's own entry in `summary.json`, because `run.json` of an `--all` run holds only the totals.

MEMORY: applied none; `docs/memory/INDEX.md` is empty. New failure worth recording: a visually hidden `.sr` span inside a clipped container that isn't positioned widens the page. Also, a loop variable named `b` overwrote the block id in every later row crop; a test now covers that.

CONCERNS:
- **No page images for most pages:** paging and the replay show "No image of this page is included." on the other 114 pages, so the replay of a report county looks thin.
- **Longer replays:** Jones takes 43 s and Lynn 50 s, against Panola's 30 s.
- **Rows with no crop:** a row selected on the sheet that has no crop shows a one-line note in the loupe instead of the scan.
- **Phone loupe:** it shows two or three of the four figures, and the column headings can be cut at its side, though no figure is.
- **Scurry and Foard:** their 17 findings are rows only the file has, so they have no crop or ring.
- **Brief's example vs data:** the brief's example whole-run line says 186 settled; the run's own figure is 168, and the line uses that.
- **Scurry page 18:** the run could not read it; the pager skips it and nothing says so.
- **First-screen height:** the first screen of a report county was not measured against a fixed height as T07b did for Panola. The card there is 16 px taller because of the column labels.
- **`hackathon.md`:** `AGENTS.md` asks for a dated entry there but the brief forbids touching it, so it is left for whoever merges.

The full report with the raw file list is in `.prod-build/reports/T07c.md`.
